import sys

def solve():
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    T = int(input[0])
    for S in input[1:T+1]:
        n = len(S)
        max_len = -1
        # Precompute all prefixes and suffixes of S for quick lookup
        prefixes = [S[:i] for i in range(1, n+1)]
        suffixes = [S[-i:] for i in range(1, n+1)]
        prefix_set = set(prefixes)
        suffix_set = set(suffixes)

        # Iterate over all possible substrings of S
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i+1, n+1):
                P = S[i:j]
                valid = True
                # Check no non-empty prefix of P is a prefix of S
                for k in range(1, len(P)+1):
                    if P[:k] in prefix_set:
                        valid = False
                        break
                if not valid:
                    continue
                # Check no non-empty suffix of P is a suffix of S
                for k in range(1, len(P)+1):
                    if P[-k:] in suffix_set:
                        valid = False
                        break
                if valid and len(P) > max_len:
                    max_len = len(P)
        print(max_len)

solve()
